query.description: To retrieve methods of a specific type
Mobile number or unique identifier of the customer
To retrieve methods from a specific related party
This is the transaction Id from the calling system. This is required if the relatedParty.id is CPG
Other information, can be a merchant identifier .ie. merchantId etc.
